about.title: About Infusion London
content: Welcome to Infusion London, where tradition meets modern taste. Based in the heart of the UK, we have spent years perfecting our craft, working with the finest tea estates globally to bring you exceptional quality.

Our mission is to provide an authentic British tea experience while embracing sustainable practices. Every leaf is handpicked, every blend meticulously tested, ensuring that your cup of tea is nothing short of perfection.
Thank you for choosing Infusion London. We look forward to being part of your daily ritual.

refund-policy.title: Refund Policy
refund-policy.content:
If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, we're here to help.

You have 30 calendar days to return an item from the date you received it. To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Once we receive your item, we will inspect it and notify you that we have received your returned item. We will immediately notify you on the status of your refund after inspecting the item.

If your return is approved, we will initiate a refund to your credit card (or original method of payment).

delivery-policy.title: Delivery Policy
delivery-policy.content:
We offer standard and express delivery options across the UK.

Standard Delivery (3-5 business days): £3.99, or free on orders over £30.
Express Delivery (1-2 business days): £5.99.

Orders placed before 2 PM GMT are dispatched the same day. You will receive a tracking link via email once your order has shipped.
